1#א: Such as an ant. Rif chapter 13 side 1.
1#ב: Or, etc. and limb, etc. — likewise Rosh from Chullin 102b "any pure bird," etc.; he holds what is stated there in any amount is mere rejection, not like Rambam; and Tosafot there s.v. "any," etc.
1#ד: And egg, etc. — learned from Rambam chapter 15 halachah 19: reason for embryo egg in chapter 3 (98a) chapter 1 — because it is her offspring they made a marker in its measure (Kesef Mishneh); though it deals with its emission (97b) "people say water," etc.; in emission even beriah is nullified as Mishnah there; gravy nosen taam — marker lest they err to nullify it itself; therefore Rambam wrote crushed egg or impure or tereifah egg — even whole suffices with sixty; and above siman 86 seif 5 ruled not like Rambam — even impure and crushed — see there.
1#ה: Even in a thousand, etc. — from what is stated there "and likewise a piece," etc., there 100 side 1 "and it requires," etc. — apparently they are equal and a fortiori even in a thousand not nullified, for it is davar sheb'minyan as Tosafot Avodah Zarah and Zevachim; Yevamot chapter 1 (3b) "if it became mixed," etc.; Zevachim chapter 8 all sacrifices, etc.; Tosefta chapter 7 Terumot forbidden piece mixed in pieces even if a thousand forbidden; not like R"SH in chapter 10 Terumot and Rashba Teshuvot HaRosh 104b who wrote nullified in 9600 from Mishnah there "every basket," etc.; Yerushalmi there — how many se'ahs make 24 logs, etc.; R"SH story of mouse one in 9600; but likewise 9600 and he holds it deals to nullify itself [Hagahot Alfasi Avodah Zarah chapter 5 siman 11 s.v. "and likewise," etc.; see Mordechai there siman 1000 second]; Ran: not so — there deals to nullify its emission as Yerushalmi — rove'a brine in sixty brines — Rabbi Avahu calculated near 200; likewise chapter 3 99b "for brine," etc. is different; he holds nosen taam until 9600; not all measures equal; likewise mouse he holds nosen taam; halachah not so — Avodah Zarah concludes sixty — see Tosafot s.v. "these" [Hagahot Alfasi there s.v. "meaning," etc.]; Rosh chapter 3 wrote mouse there is place and ruled in fish brine; likewise Rambam in commentary and composition — he holds specifically in a thousand — see there.
1#ו: And it does not have the status, etc. — as Ran wrote: three conditions — life, forbidden from creation, whole; but Tosafot and Rosh did not require life — required "if divided its name no longer applies," etc.; in Y"M wrote as Ran — Shulchan Aruch ruled leniently all conditions.
1#ח: And likewise must, etc. — to exclude, etc. Chullin 102b and Rashi there s.v. "impure," etc.
1#ט: And ox condemned to stoning. Ran; and as stated in chapter 8 Zevachim and they are nullified in majority, etc.
1#י: And likewise must, etc. — to exclude milk. As stated in chapter 8 Yoma and chapter 98 and other places milk only in kezayit; Rosh wrote also orlah and kilayim in 200 — Shulchan Aruch omitted because no life in them.
1#כ: And likewise must, etc. Makot 16b — even one missing limb — unresolved in Nazir 51b — not resolved — d'rabbanan doubt lenient as stated beginning siman 101 in hagahah — see there.
1#ל: And essence of gid, etc. Chullin 96 side 1.
1#מ: And it is, etc. — meaning in a large ox. There.
2#א: But its fat, etc. Temurah 97b "those fats," etc.; there R' Nachman gid in sixty — therefore not the gid body itself which is not nullified as Mishnah there — only its emission; cannot say Ravina and R' Nachman the last ones hold unlike halachah — only because of its fat Ran unlike Tosafot there side 1 s.v. "for it is different" in the name of Rabbi Meir.
2#ב: And requires sixty, etc. (even if melted — R' Nachman gid in sixty refers to Mishnah who hold nosen taam in gidim per first explanation in Rosh). As stated 98 side 1 "do not treat lightly," etc.; and what I wrote siman 98 seif 8 (and above siman 65 s.k. 25).
2#ד: With its gid. And according to hagahah siman 73 and 92 when not attached.
2#ה: And if melted, etc. — like when not recognized; and nullified in sixty since crushed as stated.
3#_: Pot, etc. — as above when not recognized and whole.
4#_: Vegetables, etc. (three, etc.) — as stated in chapter HaBayit 64b; Rashba and Nimukei Yosef there — uncertain which halachah — therefore in marriage danger stringent; vesetot d'rabbanan lenient; likewise ox mu'ad money stays in presumption; lashes and stoning because violated karet stringent — "wicked shall be consumed" — likewise here d'rabbanan lenient.
